title: Welcome to Notice Board System
content: Welcome to the Department Notice Board System! This is a centralized platform for all department announcements and important notices. You can add, edit, view, and delete notices here. All notices are displayed in reverse chronological order (latest first).
author: Admin

title: Fall Semester Registration
content: All students are required to complete their fall semester registration by September 30th. Please visit the registrar's office or use the online portal. Late registration will incur additional fees.
author: Registrar Office

title: Campus Maintenance - Building A
content: Building A will undergo plumbing maintenance from October 1st to October 5th. Some facilities may be temporarily unavailable. We apologize for any inconvenience.
author: Facilities Manager
